segments.text: Before we start, is it okay if I talk a little slower and face you the whole time?
Yes, thank you. I'm also using captions on my phone, so I can read everything you say.
Perfect. Your blood pressure is better than in March, but still a bit high. I'd like to add one tablet in the morning, with breakfast.
Can that make my tinnitus or my balance worse? I get dizzy sometimes.
Good question. Some people feel light-headed in the first week. Stand up slowly, and if the dizziness gets worse, call the practice the same day.
Okay. Could I have the name of the tablet and the dose in writing?
Of course, it'll be on the printout. And let's do a blood test in two weeks and see each other again in three months.
